info.name: P03 - Hotel Room Booking & Reservation Platform
info.description:
CIA-3, Advanced JavaScript Backend Frameworks (Node.js & Express JS).

Run order matters: folder 00 proves the end-to-end journey, folders M1-M13 cover every module in order, and folder 99 holds the required negative-path matrix.

Before running: start the API (npm run dev) and seed the database (npm run seed). Select the "P03 - Local" environment, then use Collection Runner from the top.

Tokens and resource ids are captured automatically by test scripts, so no manual copy-paste is needed anywhere.
